children.name: hyprland.conf
children.content:
# Architect's Hyprland Config
# Less is more. Built for maximum efficiency.

monitor=,preferred,auto,1
exec-once = waybar & hyprpaper

# Core bindings
bind = SUPER, Return, exec, kitty
bind = SUPER, C, killactive,
bind = SUPER, M, exit,

# Note to recruiter/visitor:
# I prefer building and configuring my own desktop environment from scratch
# to fully understand how the underlying X11/Wayland systems interact.

name: .env
content:
APP_NAME="Alfarizqi_Portfolio_TUI"
APP_ENV="production"
APP_DEBUG=false

DB_CONNECTION="supabase"
DB_DATABASE="umkm"

# --- EASTER EGG ---
# Congratulations on finding the hidden dotfiles!
# You clearly know your way around a Linux filesystem.

CURRENT_STATUS="Open to Opportunities & Scholarships"
COFFEE_INTAKE="Critical"
SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE="Overclocked"

name: .bash_history
content:
sudo pacman -Syu
sudo dkms install -m nvidia -v current

cargo new aegis --bin
cd aegis && cargo build --release

cd ~/projects/umkm-pos
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed

gcloud run deploy juaravibecoding-app --source .

echo 'Thanks for finding this file!' > /dev/stdout
history -c

content.name: Alfarizqi Himam Harakan
content.about: Systems enthusiast focusing on robust backend architecture, cloud deployment, and proactive security auditing. As an Arch Linux daily driver, I thrive in terminal-centric environments and strongly advocate for building minimal, highly efficient workflows over bloated abstractions. My technical journey spans from developing full-stack relational systems to exploring low-level systems programming. I am deeply passionate about uncovering vulnerabilities, optimizing server performance, and architecting secure, scalable solutions. Whether I'm configuring a tiling window manager, deploying containerized applications, or writing backend logic, my philosophy remains the same: keep it lightweight, secure, and blazingly fast.
